system.lightMode.note: Isebenzisa ujongano lweWindows olukhanyayo; kucetyiswa kwi-e-ink.
system.lightMode.unavailable: Kufuneka uhlaziyo lweWindows 10 lukaMeyi 2019 okanye olutsha.
saturation.unavailable: Kufuneka iWindows 11 24H2 okanye entsha kunye nesikrini esixhasa iACM.
saturation.unsupported.upgrade: Ukutshintsha ukutyeba kombala ngeE-Ink Assistant akuxhaswa kwesi sikrini. iWindows 11 24H2 okanye entsha inokongeza inkxaso; kungenjalo, kutshintshe kwiphaneli yolawulo lweGPU.
saturation.unsupported.driver: Ukutshintsha ukutyeba kombala ngeE-Ink Assistant akuxhaswa kwesi sikrini ngeGPU/ngedrayiva yangoku. Zama ukuhlaziya idrayiva yemizobo okanye kutshintshe kwiphaneli yolawulo lweGPU.
saturation.manual: Izilawuli zokutyeba kombala neRGB zicinyiwe. Ungazitshintsha ngesandla nakwiphaneli yolawulo lweGPU.
saturation.unsupported.clone: iWindows ayikwazi ukufaka ukutyeba kombala okanye iRGB kwimo yokuphinda umfanekiso. Tshintshela kwimo yokwandisa ukuze usebenzise ezi zilawuli.
display.cloneWarning: Imo yokuphinda umfanekiso ivuliwe. Olunye uhlengahlengiso lwesikrini luchaphazela noku: %1.
saturation.experimental.preparing: Uvavanyo luza kuqala kwimizuzwana eyi%1. Ukuba isikrini asibonakali kakuhle, iisetingi zangaphambili ziya kubuyiselwa ngokuzenzekelayo.
saturation.experimental.confirm: Hlola isikrini. Ukuba awuqinisekisi, iisetingi zangaphambili ziya kubuyiselwa ngokuzenzekelayo kwimizuzwana eyi%1.
saturation.experimental.dialog.preparing: Kuza kufakwa utshintsho oluncinci lokutyeba kombala. Jonga ubumnyama obungaqhelekanga, ukutshintsha kwemibala okanye ukulahleka kokubonakala.
saturation.experimental.dialog.confirm.b: Qinisekisa kuphela xa kungekho bumnyama bungaqhelekanga, kutshintsha kwemibala okanye kulahleka kokubonakala. Kungenjalo buyisela; iisetingi ziya kubuyiselwa ngokuzenzekelayo nazo.
saturation.acm: Isebenzisa ulawulo lombala oluzenzekelayo lweWindows. Isetingi yokuqala iyabuyiselwa xa uphuma kwi-app.
shaking.unavailable: Akukho silawuli sikhuselekileyo sikawonke-wonke sokudibanisa iithoni ngamachaphaza kwisikrini ngasinye kule GPU kwiWindows.
night.title: Isibane sasebusuku
night.note: iWindows ilawula isibane sasebusuku kwinkqubo yonke endaweni yesikrini ngasinye.
night.fallback.recommendation: Sicebisa ukucima isibane sasebusuku kwizikrini ze-e-ink.
night.disable.title: Cima isibane sasebusuku
night.disable.note: Isibane sasebusuku songeza umbala ofudumeleyo; sicime kwi-e-ink.
night.disable.warning: Kwizikrini ze-e-ink, sicebisa ukucima isibane sasebusuku.
help.windows: Ukutyeba kombala neRGB zisebenzisa ulawulo lombala oluzenzekelayo kwiWindows 11 24H2 okanye entsha, okanye indlela yeprofayile yeMHC2 kwiWindows 10 iinguqulelo 19041–19045. Umahluko wombhalo, Ukuphucula ividiyo neZongezelelekileyo zisebenzisa igophe legamma kwisikrini ngasinye. Lonke uhlengahlengiso lwesikrini lubuyiselwa xa uphuma kwi-app luze lufakwe kwakhona xa uqalisa.
welcome.windows.tray: Vula imenyu yee-ayikhoni ezifihliweyo ngasekunene kwebha yemisebenzi, fumana le ayikhoni yamaphepha encwadi, uze uyitsalele kwindawo ebonakalayo.
welcome.windows.tray.title: Qhoboshela i-ayikhoni kwitreyi
